title: THE GIFT OF KNOWLEDGE: SEEING THROUGH DIVINE EYES

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "To one there is given through the Spirit a message of wisdom, to another a message of knowledge by means of the same Spirit..." - 1 Corinthians 12:8

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
In 1 Corinthians 12:8, the Apostle Paul outlines the spiritual gifts distributed by the Holy Spirit, highlighting the "word of knowledge." Unlike human intellect or academic study, this gift is a supernatural revelation a sudden, divine insight granted to a believer to understand God's heart, a person's hidden situation, or spiritual truths that cannot be known through natural means.

While the word of wisdom generally points to the practical application of divine truth in a specific situation, the word of knowledge often pertains to the revelation of facts, deep spiritual realities, or hidden circumstances. Throughout Scripture and church history, this gift has served to build up the body of Christ, comfort the hurting, and confirm God's active presence. It reminds us that God is intimately acquainted with every detail of our lives and desires to communicate His truth directly to His children. This gift is what we need today, and God eagerly awaits to pour out His Spirit upon the body of Christ.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "God uses ordinary people through whom He chooses to manifest His extraordinary wisdom and knowledge, not to exalt human pride, but to draw hearts closer to His grace."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, thank You for generously bestowing Your spiritual gifts upon the body of Christ. Open our spiritual eyes and ears to receive the wisdom and knowledge that come from Your Spirit. Cleanse our hearts so that when You reveal Your truths or lead us to minister to others, we do so with humility, profound love, and absolute dependence on You. In Jesus' name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: God sees you right where you are, knowing every unspoken burden and hidden joy in your heart. May you walk in the confidence that His Spirit is actively guiding, teaching, and illuminating your path today.
